verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-markdown scraping API, so scheduling recurring scraping jobs is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows only one-off, on-demand requests (r.jina.ai and s.jina.ai calls with per-request headers) and no built-in scheduler, cron, or recurring-job feature. Caching, the self-hostable container, and timing headers are adjacent features and do not deliver a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times
